panel.placeholder: Hover any metric or card to see an explanation.

price_stat.title: Median Price
price_stat.text: Median selling price across all ranked products. Your landed cost must support a price within 20% of this value to remain competitive on search ranking and conversion rate.

revenue_stat.title: Estimated Monthly Revenue
revenue_stat.text: Estimated monthly revenue per SKU, modeled from BSR velocity data. Median filters out hero-SKU outliers. A high median in a fragmented field signals accessible, recurring demand.

rating_stat.title: Rating & Reviews
rating_stat.text: Average rating and review count across top-ranked products. Markets above 4.3 stars with high review counts require a differentiated listing or aggressive launch spend to gain traction.

social_stat.title: Social Proof Signals
social_stat.text: Bought-in-past-month count and Q&A volume — Amazon's published demand signals. High purchase counts with low review totals indicate an active niche with a low barrier to capturing early social proof.

fba_fees_stat.title: FBA Fees
fba_fees_stat.text: FBA pick-pack-ship cost driven by product dimensions and weight. If total Amazon fees (FBA plus referral) exceed 35% of retail price, net margin before ad spend is structurally thin.

certifications.title: Regulatory Certifications
certifications.text: Regulatory requirements active in this category. Each badge is a legal prerequisite — lab testing, registration, or periodic renewal — that must be cleared before an ASIN can go live on Amazon.

market_share.title: Market Share by Brand
market_share.text: Revenue distribution across brands. Inner ring shows brand-level share of niche revenue; outer ring shows per-product share within each brand. Concentrated share in one brand signals a dominant entrenched competitor.

product_images.title: Product Gallery
product_images.text: Primary images of the top-ranked products in this category. Use this to assess current packaging norms, photography style conventions, and visual differentiation gaps in the competitive set.

related_keywords.title: Related Keyword Suggestions
related_keywords.text: Semantically adjacent search terms derived from vector similarity of product embeddings, not keyword co-occurrence. Surfaces neighboring niches and long-tail demand clusters worth validating before committing to sourcing.

top_categories.title: Top Categories
top_categories.text: Browse nodes Amazon assigns to products matching this search. Your selected node determines your BSR ladder, eligibility for category-specific badges, and the set of competing ASINs you rank against.

price_dist.title: Price Distribution
price_dist.text: Revenue-weighted price spread across ranked products. The peak cluster shows where buying concentrates. Pricing above it requires clear premium differentiation; below it signals low quality perception and compresses unit margin.
